properties.name: The detectors distinguish a parked idea and the loop's count throws it away — 44 of 89 "outstanding structural defects" are info, and 13 say "parked" in their own message
properties.statement:
ROOT-CAUSED 2026-09-10 from the hxm_program report, and REPRODUCED ON REFLOW2'S OWN GRAPH at 0.58.0 rather than reasoned about.

THE SYMPTOM AS REPORTED, three times: "Defects went 2 -> 7 over a day of doing the right thing, and loop_status repeats '7 structural defects outstanding' to the user at every check" (F-03); "raised the '1 structural defect' line in loop_status for the whole session, then 3 as more brainstorms linked ... the loop_status line reads as debt" (F-11); "defects 12 -> 16 (brainstorm ANTICIPATES + orphan proposed decision, F-03/F-11 class)" (2026-09-09→10, on 0.56.0).

⭐ THE OBVIOUS DIAGNOSIS IS WRONG, AND THAT IS THE POINT. F-03 and F-11 both propose the fix "exempt brainstormed ideas from the defect detectors". THAT FIX ALREADY SHIPPED. `is_parked_idea` (heal.rs) landed 2026-08-26 in v0.41.0 — a Decision with `status: proposed` and `kind != choice` — and it is consulted by the relation categories, including the `unresolved_setup` path the reports name. hxm's last session ran 0.56.0, FIFTEEN RELEASES LATER, and the symptom persisted. So the exemption is not missing, and re-filing it would have fixed nothing.

MEASURED HERE, `detect_defects` on reflow2's own design at 0.58.0:

    total defects                                     89
      by severity      info      44
                       warning   45
      by category      contradiction      33
                       unresolved_setup   22
                       orphan_node        19
                       unthreaded_cluster 11
                       untriaged_report    3
                       duplicate           1
    info-level defects whose OWN MESSAGE contains "parked"    13

    what loop_status says: "89 structural defect(s) outstanding"

⭐⭐ THE CAUSE IS A DISTINCTION COMPUTED AND THEN DISCARDED AT THE REPORTING BOUNDARY. The detector knows. Its own message reads "Decision 'dec:idea-...' has no links yet — A PARKED DECISION POINT, recorded but governing nothing", severity `info`. It has identified the node as parked, labelled it as such in prose, and emitted it anyway; then `loop_status` collapses 44 info and 45 warning into ONE severity-blind number and puts it in `next` on every call. The fix in v0.41.0 was applied to the DETECTORS; the summary line was never taught the difference.

TWO DISTINCT SUB-CASES, and conflating them is what made the reports read as one unfixed bug:
  (a) `orphan_node` on an unlinked parked idea — fires by design, at info, self-labelled parked. This is hxm's "orphan proposed decision".
  (b) `unresolved_setup` on ANTICIPATES between two PROPOSED brainstorms — genuinely exempt since v0.41.0. Every such finding remaining on this graph joins ACCEPTED decisions (e.g. dec:merge-survivor-provenance -> dec:a-tied-merge-breaks-by-degree-not-by-alphabet), where firing is CORRECT.
So F-11 as originally filed is FIXED, and the surviving complaint is (a) plus the count.

⭐ THE CLASS: a computed distinction that does not survive to the surface a person reads. This project has fixed the same shape before — `swept.parked` counts parked nodes instead of filing them, `detect_gaps` reports `by_source` under budget, `report-dont-judge` keeps the judgement with the reader. The instrument here is one rung short: `detect_defects` is severity-aware and category-aware, and the one line the user actually sees on every call is neither.

⚠️ NOT ESTABLISHED. Whether hxm's specific nodes carried `kind: choice` (which would defeat the exemption legitimately) is unmeasurable from here — their graph is on their machine. The 13-of-44 figure is reflow2's own design and may not be representative of a hub graph. And no fix is proposed here: whether the answer is a severity split in `next`, a session-scoped snooze (their F-14), or a `since_last_call` delta is a design question nobody has put to the owner.
